messages:
support-alex: Hey team — customer `acme-corp` (prod, region: us-west-2) is seeing intermittent stream resets / 5xx for long streaming generates. They report ~10-15% of streaming requests fail after ~40-60s with a 502 or 504, SDK retries are ramping and causing duplicate billing. Attached: minimal repro steps and a python snippet.

sre-janet: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the repro steps here and confirm whether they're using our HTTP/2 streaming or websockets? Any client-side logs showing `RST_STREAM` or `REFUSED_STREAM`?

support-alex: They're on the official python SDK v0.8.2 using http2 streaming (not websocket). Repro (from customer):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  --data '{"model":"redwood-1-medium","stream":true,"input":"<long prompt>"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```
Client logs show repeated: `stream reset: RST_STREAM(2)` then a 502 from gateway. They also attached server-side request ids: `rid=usw2-9d3a`.

runtime-li: Noted. I pulled edge metrics and see a small spike in `http2.stream_resets` and `upstream_5xx_rate` for `us-west-2` starting ~1768999000 (about 2 hours ago). We deployed a change to keepalive/idle timeouts ~3h ago to reduce idle conn churn. That could have unintentionally lowered `SETTINGS.max_concurrent_streams` on the proxy pool or changed TCP keepalive behavior.

pm-mia: Customer impact looks non-trivial. We need a quick mitigation + customer comms. Quick mitigation options: 1) temporary rollback of the keepalive change in US-WEST-2, 2) advise customer to disable HTTP/2 multiplexing (sdk setting) or add `Connection: close` as a workaround, 3) increase proxy `max_concurrent_streams` and bump stream window. Which is fastest?

sre-janet: Fastest is 2) + 1). We'll ask infra to rollback the keepalive tweak for US-WEST-2 immediately and ask the customer to try `Connection: close` in the meantime. Also request pcap/traces if they can.

support-alex: Sent workaround to customer (suggested setting `session.http2_enable=False` in python SDK or adding header `Connection: close`). Customer tried `Connection: close` and reported failures drop from ~12% -> ~1.2% in a 20m test.

runtime-li: Good repro signal. I'm kicking off a rollback of the keepalive/timeout change for the US-WEST-2 edge pool. Will monitor `upstream_5xx_rate`, `http2.stream_resets`, and `latency.p95`.

incident-bot: deploy-rollback: rollback "edge-keepalive-tweak" to version 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z in region us-west-2 started by runtime-li. Change ticket: #INC-3821.

support-alex: Customer updated — workaround worked and they've paused traffic to other regions while we stabilize. I'll keep them posted and follow up once p95/5xx have normalized. Thanks everyone. :pray:
